openItems.info: Invoices not yet (fully) paid – earliest due date first. Click a row to open the invoice. Prior years are held in the opening balance and are hidden here by default.

ledger.title: Account Ledger
ledger.info: General ledger account statement: pick an account and a period to see all postings with opening and running balance. Click a row to open the full transaction with counter accounts.
ledger.emptyInRange: There are no entries on {account} in the selected period.
ledger.emptyEverywhere: There are no entries on {account} at all.
ledger.pickHint: Type an account number or name

reports.title: Reports
reports.info: The trial balance lists every account with what was posted to it in the period: opening balance, debit, credit and closing balance. Click a row to open the account sheet with the individual entries.
reports.unbalanced: Debit and credit differ — please check
reports.name: Name
reports.noRows: Nothing was posted to any account in the selected period.

documentCheck.title: Document check
documentCheck.info: Every document carries a checksum (SHA-256) taken when it was stored. This page reads each file again and recomputes it, revealing files that were replaced or have gone missing — and documents with no owner or no booking.
documentCheck.allGood: {count} documents checked — all unchanged and present.
documentCheck.tampered: Warning: {changed} documents were altered after storage, {missing} files are missing. Both belong on your accountant’s desk.
documentCheck.notAllChecked: {count} further documents were not checked this time.

manual.title: Enter Incoming Invoice
manual.info: Manually post a vendor invoice – without scanning. Choose the vendor, enter invoice number, date and amounts, assign the expense account and post. This immediately creates a real incoming invoice that can be paid via bank or cash.
manual.vendorSearchHint: Type at least two letters to search
manual.expenseAccountHint: Search account (number or name), e.g. 5400 Goods received
manual.scanHint: Got the invoice as PDF or photo? Have it read automatically.

chartOfAccounts.title: Chart of Accounts
chartOfAccounts.subtitle: Manage the chart of accounts – master data, tax automation and VAT return
chartOfAccounts.info: Manage the chart of accounts here: account number, description, category and especially the tax keys (tax automation/VAT return). How to use: click an account in the list, check the data, optionally add a tax key with a "valid from" date and save. Important: if an account has no valid tax key, no tax can be posted on it in booking dialogs (red "Tax key missing").
chartOfAccounts.taxHint: Tax keys without a "valid from" date are ignored. Without a valid tax key, the account cannot post tax in booking dialogs.
chartOfAccounts.datevautomatikHint: Tax is derived automatically from the account when posting.
chartOfAccounts.otherSettingsHint: Position in the cash-basis income statement and in the BWA. Leave empty if the account is not shown in that report.
chartOfAccounts.usageHint: Controls which booking screens offer this account. A summary account collects the contra entries and must therefore never be selectable in a screen.
chartOfAccounts.lockedPosted: This account already has transactions. Account type and links are locked so existing entries keep their assignment.
chartOfAccounts.headingHint: Headings only structure the chart of accounts. Nothing is posted to them, so taxkeys, links, report positions and successor account do not apply.
chartOfAccounts.successorHint: From the effective date on, entries go to the successor account instead. Only accounts with identical links are offered.
chartOfAccounts.successorNoCandidates: No account with identical links available
chartOfAccounts.successorActive: The successor account has been active since {date} and can no longer be changed.
chartOfAccounts.linkUnmapped: This account uses the unusual link "{link}", which cannot be represented here. It is kept unchanged.

overview.title: Accounting
overview.info: This overview shows the state of your accounting at a glance – all figures come from the real general ledger (including kivitendo). Income and expenses are shown for the current year (with month and previous month below), plus output/input VAT for the return and open receivables and payables. Pending AI documents only concern scanned invoices still awaiting approval. Click a tile to jump to the matching area.
overview.trendHint: Net excluding tax, from the real general ledger (current month omitted). The most recent month (dashed) is often still being booked and therefore usually incomplete.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.info: Review and edit the booking proposals the AI created when you uploaded the purchase invoices. How it works: check the booking (accounts, amount, tax), edit if needed and then click "Approve" – this posts the document to the general ledger and the status changes to "Posted". Discard wrong proposals with "Reject". "Sent to DATEV" means the booking was already part of a DATEV export. Tip: use the status filter to work through the pending bookings first.
bookings.infoJournal: The real booking journal from the general ledger – all actually posted sales and purchase invoices plus manual GL entries (including those made in kivitendo). Click a row to see its debit/credit lines. Switch to "AI proposals" to approve scanned documents.
bookings.noJournal: No bookings in the selected period.
bookings.noLines: This document has no ledger lines — it was recorded but not yet posted to the general ledger.
bookings.needVendorHint: Please assign a vendor first – opening the document now.
bookings.journalTruncated: Showing the latest {shown} of {total} – narrow by date.
bookings.editHint: Account, description or amounts wrong? Correct them before approving – afterwards the document is in the general ledger and can only be reversed.

upload.title: Incoming Invoices
upload.info: Upload your incoming invoices here as PDF or image. The AI (Weroni) automatically reads vendor, amounts and tax and creates a booking suggestion. How to use: drag a file into the field or click it, wait briefly for the analysis – then review and approve it under "Bookings". The lower section shows the invoices already booked.
upload.dropzone: Drop PDF here or click to browse
upload.dropzoneHint: Weroni will analyze the invoice automatically
upload.duplicate: This document has already been uploaded
upload.autoBooked: Booked automatically – the incoming invoice is an open item, payable via bank/cash.
upload.reviewNeeded: Queued for review – please check and post.
upload.reviewVendor: Vendor not unique – assign it in review, then it will be posted.
upload.noInvoices: No incoming invoices booked yet. Upload your first invoice above.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.info: Manage your vendor master data here. How it works: find a vendor via the search, click to edit it or create one with "New vendor". Use "Find duplicates" to detect vendors created twice and merge them: never-used duplicates are deleted, booked ones are only set to inactive — all bookings are kept either way. The Created/Bookings/Total columns show since when and how much has been recorded per vendor.
vendors.name: Name
vendors.mergeExplain: "{merged}" is not deleted but flagged as inactive and hidden from the list. All invoices, orders, documents and rules of both vendors are then attached to "{keep}" — no booking is lost, even if both had bookings. The name and IBAN of "{merged}" are stored as an alias so future documents are recognised automatically.
vendors.mergeExplainDelete: "{merged}" is deleted permanently. This is possible because no invoice, order, rule or settlement refers to it — nothing is lost and it no longer appears in any vendor selection. Name and IBAN are stored as an alias on "{keep}" beforehand so document recognition still matches that spelling. Contacts and shipping addresses of the duplicate are removed with it.
vendors.deleteDone: "{merged}" deleted — the spelling is kept as an alias on "{keep}"

datev.title: DATEV Export
datev.info: Hands the approved bookings to your tax advisor. Pick a period, check the preview, then export. "Export CSV" contains the booking batch in DATEV format only. "Export with documents (ZIP)" additionally contains every scanned invoice plus a document list and checksums – this is the version for your tax advisor and for a tax audit. Enter the advisor and client number once on the left; you get them from your tax advisor.
datev.noBookings: No approved bookings in selected period
datev.packageHint: The ZIP contains the booking batch, the document list and {withDoc} of {total} scanned documents – for your tax advisor and for a tax audit.

outgoing.title: Incoming Payments
outgoing.subtitle: Automatic matching of incoming payments with open outgoing invoices
outgoing.info: This page automatically matches received bank payments with your open outgoing invoices – detected by amount and invoice number in the payment reference (incl. cash discount). How to use: check the suggestions and click "Book" to assign the payment to the invoice; the invoice is then posted as paid to the general ledger. Prerequisite: the bank statements were imported beforehand under Banking.
outgoing.alreadySettledHint: Note: {count} of the open bank receipts reference an invoice that is already fully paid. Those payments are therefore already posted – only the bank movement was never marked as done. Nothing to do here.

alerts.uploadSuccess: Invoice analyzed and booking suggestion created

ustva.title: VAT return
ustva.cashHint: Based on payment. Partial payments are attributed proportionally to the invoice's tax structure.
ustva.methodOverride: Differs from the client default ({method}) — for comparison only, not for filing.
ustva.clickHint: Click a box to see the underlying entries
ustva.reopenConfirm: Undo filing? The period will be open again afterwards.
ustva.fileConfirm: Mark the return for {period} as filed? The figures are stored as a snapshot.
ustva.noElsterHint: OpensourceERP does not transmit to the tax authority itself. Copy the individual figures or hand the CSV to your tax advisor.

checks.title: Checks
checks.noTaxkey: {count} revenue entries without a tax key ({amount})
checks.noTaxkeyOk: All revenue entries have a tax key
checks.lateBookings: {count} entries posted after filing — check for a correction

unmapped.title: Not mapped
unmapped.text: These amounts belong in the return but cannot be assigned to a box. They are shown here rather than dropped.

mapping.title: Tax key mapping
mapping.text: Defines which box an entry flows into. An entry with an account takes precedence over the general one.

excluded.title: Deliberately not reported
excluded.text: These amounts are mapped but belong in no box of the form — pass-through items, for example. They are shown here so it stays visible that the decision was made.

customers.title: Customers
customers.info: Customer master data from the accounting side: search, find customers created twice and merge them. Never-invoiced duplicates are deleted, already invoiced ones are only set to inactive — all invoices are kept either way. Clicking a row opens the customer in the customer module, where creating and editing still happens.
customers.name: Name
customers.mergeExplain: "{merged}" is not deleted but flagged as inactive and hidden from the list. All invoices, orders, quotations, projects and documents of both customers are then attached to "{keep}" — no invoice is lost, even if both were invoiced. The call history moves along.
customers.mergeExplainDelete: "{merged}" is deleted permanently. This is possible because no invoice, order, project or rule refers to it — nothing is lost and it no longer appears in any customer selection. Contacts and shipping addresses are removed with it, the call history moves to "{keep}".

easymode.label: Accounting mode
easymode.easyHint: Everyday wording, no debit and credit columns, only the work at hand.
easymode.proHint: Professional wording with journal entry, tax rate, ledger and chart of accounts.

palette.placeholder: Type an account, customer, vendor, document number or destination
palette.hint: From two characters on, accounts, partners and documents are searched.
palette.reportsHint: Every account with opening balance, debit, credit and closing balance

cockpit.autoBooked: {count} documents were posted automatically this week.
cockpit.dropHint: Drop documents anywhere on this page — PDF, JPG or PNG.
cockpit.dropSub: PDF, JPG or PNG. Recognition starts right away.
cockpit.dropWrongType: Only PDF, JPG and PNG can be read.
cockpit.dropDone: {count} documents are now in the stack.
cockpit.dropFailed: The document could not be read.

tiles.closingSub: {bank} bank entries and {docs} documents still open
tiles.checksSub: Difference of {amount} between invoice and account

checks.title: Invoice and account disagree
checks.info: The receivables or payables account must carry exactly the invoice’s open amount. If the balance differs, a payment was posted to the wrong account or a posting is missing. Click a row to open the account ledger.

run.emptySub: This stack is empty. That is exactly how it should be.
run.noDocumentHint: There is no file attached to this entry.
run.noCandidate: There is no suggestion for this payment. Use “Change” to find the matching invoice.
run.searchInvoiceHint: Type an invoice number or a name
run.noUndoHint: Approved documents are posted — corrections need a reversal entry.
run.sentenceDocument: {vendor} charges {amount} with {rate} input tax, posted to {account}.
run.accountSearchHint: Type an account number or name

concept.tooltip: The complete accounting concept with diagrams: how receipts, bank, cash, accounts and VAT fit together.
